description:
**TSP Ant System with local-search feedback.** The input is a symmetric nonnegative distance matrix. Ant System constructs a complete permutation for each ant using pheromone and distance.

The improvement callback applies 2-opt descent, a 3-opt reconnection and another 2-opt descent. It returns the changed vertex order before both the all-time best update and the pheromone deposit. Subsequent ants therefore sample from the reinforced edges of locally improved tours.

The controller uses all-ant deposits of Ant System and a fixed number of ants per round. The local-improvement chain is the project variant. Returned tour quality does not depend on a reported unverified fitness field.
